canonical_project: Ankum Sondergebiet Rechenzentrum am Lordsee / HANSALOG-HDS
owner: HANSALOG GmbH & Co. KG / HDS-Rechenzentrum GmbH
notes: B-Plan Nr. 66 with parallel FNP amendment creates a Sondergebiet (special area) for a data center at Am Lordsee 1, Ankum, Landkreis Osnabrück, on the HANSALOG/HDS site; about 1.8 ha, prior demolition in 2021. Land-use planning stage; no MW disclosed.
